project_description: Production-grade FastAPI backend with auth (JWT+OAuth+RBAC) and LLM chat proxy domains.

__prompts__.project_slug: URL/repo slug (auto-derived from project_name — leave blank to accept)
__prompts__.package_name: Python package name under src/ (auto-derived from project_slug — leave blank to accept)
__prompts__.python_version: Python version (3.12 or 3.13 required — both are >= 3.12)
__prompts__.fastapi_host: Host address the FastAPI Uvicorn process binds to
__prompts__.fastapi_port: TCP port the FastAPI Uvicorn process listens on
__prompts__.postgres_host: PostgreSQL host (use 'localhost' when running app on host)
__prompts__.postgres_password: PostgreSQL application password (override via env in prod)
__prompts__.redis_host: Redis host (use 'localhost' when running app on host)
__prompts__.mailpit_smtp_port: Mailpit SMTP port for local dev email capture
__prompts__.jwt_refresh_ttl_days: Refresh token TTL in days (default: 7) — rotation + reuse detection enabled
__prompts__.include_chat_domain: Scaffold the LangChain + langchain-litellm LLM chat proxy domain?
__prompts__.llm_provider: Default LLM provider adapter (ignored when include_chat_domain=no)
__prompts__.llm_default_model: Default model name for the selected LLM provider
__prompts__.oauth_providers: OAuth2 social login providers to scaffold (comma-separated; unselected adapters are removed post-gen)
